item.title: Brewster Fire rescues two people in distress on a trail near Wings Neck Beach
item.description: BREWSTER – Two people and a dog were rescued by Brewster firefighters after running into distress on a trail near Wings Neck Beach. Crews put the people in survival suits to get through the ice to safety. They were evaluated for possible hypothermia. item.title: LISTEN: Sandwich opioid abatement funds supporting community recovery events
item.description: Sandwich Director of Community Services Guy Boucher says the town has received $115,000 in opioid settlement fund grants and it’s going into addiction and outreach resources. They have planned several family friendly events to allow residents to reach out to a new town social worker and get connected with local resources. item.description: NANTUCKET – State officials have announced $343,985 in grants to restore and protect wildlife habitat, including almost $150,000 in funding to support a pair of projects protecting pitch pine and scrub oak habitats in Martha’s Vineyard and Nantucket. item.title: Traffic crash injures 1, closes lanes of Route 6 in Eastham
item.description: EASTHAM – A traffic crash sent one person to Cape Cod Hospital and forced traffic detours. The collision happened on State Highway (Route 6) between Massasoit Road and Old County Road shortly before 9 AM Monday. Eastham Police are investigating the cause of the crash. item.title: Updated 1 PM: No injuries after fire truck hits utility pole in Provincetown, adjacent medical clinic closed for the day
item.description: PROVINCETOWN – A Provincetown Fire engine reportedly collided with a utility pole about 11 AM Monday. The crash happened on Harry Kemp Way by Outer Cape Health Services. No injuries were reported. According to radio traffic, the engine was returning from a medical emergency when the crash occurred. Eversource was called to repair the damage. item.title: Firefighters extricate driver after vehicle crashes into woods in Yarmouth
item.description: YARMOUTH – Firefighters had to extricate the driver of a Pontiac Vibe station wagon after a collision sent it into some woods. The crash happened about 7 PM on Station Avenue at Starbuck Lane. Both drivers were treated and released at the scene. Yarmouth Police are investigating the cause of the crash.
